description: Retrieval evaluation set. Each question lists the section(s) a correct answer must cite. Questions are phrased the way a non-lawyer would actually type them, not in statute language, because that is the gap retrieval has to close. Every expected section was verified to exist in backend/data/raw before this file was written.
